shortDefinition: The process of searching for and fetching relevant information from a data source.
fullDefinition: In AI systems, retrieval refers to the process of searching a corpus of documents or data to find the most relevant pieces for a given query. This is done before generation in RAG systems. Retrieval can be keyword-based (traditional search) or semantic (embedding-based). The quality of retrieval directly determines the quality of RAG-augmented responses — if the wrong documents are retrieved, the answer will be wrong.
